All keeps the text of a hidden element and template content

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>visible</p><div role="tabpanel" hidden>tab two body</div><template><p>row template</p></template>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(hidden_content: 'All'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
